rationale: Every service line on claim PA28755879 was denied CO-16 (claim/service lacks information or has submission/billing error). The claim-level MOA remark N286 pinpoints the defect: missing/incomplete/invalid referring provider primary identifier. Reviewing the 837P, the claim party loops include a billing provider (loop 85, NPI 1110692305) and a rendering provider (loop 82, Mary Clark NPI 1992501921), but no referring provider loop (2310A) — the referring provider NPI was simply omitted. Medicare Part B requires a referring/ordering provider NPI on outpatient therapy claims billed under POS 11. The defect is a claim-data omission, not a substantive coverage dispute. Because the payer is Medicare Part B FFS, a frequency-7 replacement claim is not permitted (CLM05-3 must be 1); the correct correction path is a Clerical Error Reopening (CER) filed with Novitas, adding the referring provider's NPI. The group code CO means the $310.83 write-down is contractual and cannot be billed to the patient while the reopening is pending.

root_cause.explanation: The 837P contained no referring provider loop (2310A). MOA remark N286 on the 835 confirms the payer rejected all four lines because the referring provider primary identifier (NPI) was absent. Medicare Part B requires a referring/ordering provider NPI on outpatient therapy claims; its omission triggered CO-16 across every service line.

next_action.detail: File a Clerical Error Reopening (CER) with Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B. Medicare Part B FFS does not accept frequency-7 replacement claims (CLM05-3 must remain 1); clerical omissions are corrected through a reopening per CMS Claims Processing Manual Ch. 34. In the reopening request, supply the referring provider's full name and NPI in loop 2310A. Obtain the referring provider's NPI from the ordering physician's records before submitting. Do not file a redetermination — this is a data omission, not a substantive coverage dispute. The reopening window is 1 year from the initial determination (production date 2026-09-23), so the deadline is 2027-09-23.
